title: Kitten eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='45' cy='75' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#f9a825'/>
    <!-- belly highlight -->
    <ellipse cx='45' cy='80' rx='15' ry='10' fill='#ffe082'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='42' cy='46' r='21' fill='#f9a825'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <polygon points='26,32 20,14 38,26' fill='#f9a825'/>
    <polygon points='29,29 25,19 36,27' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
    <polygon points='58,32 64,14 46,26' fill='#f9a825'/>
    <polygon points='55,29 59,19 48,27' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <ellipse cx='34' cy='44' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#3b1f5e'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#3b1f5e'/>
    <circle cx='35.5' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='51.5' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- muzzle -->
    <ellipse cx='42' cy='56' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#ffe082'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <polygon points='40,53 44,53 42,56' fill='#ff8fab'/>
    <!-- mouth open -->
    <path d='M36 58 Q42 68 48 58 Q42 62 36 58 Z' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
    <!-- whiskers -->
    <line x1='20' y1='52' x2='31' y2='55' stroke='#e08a20' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='20' y1='58' x2='31' y2='58' stroke='#e08a20' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='53' y1='55' x2='64' y2='52' stroke='#e08a20' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='53' y1='58' x2='64' y2='58' stroke='#e08a20' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <!-- paw holding snack -->
    <ellipse cx='58' cy='62' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ffe082'/>
    <!-- snack (fish treat) -->
    <ellipse cx='66' cy='58' rx='11' ry='7' fill='#81c784'/>
    <polygon points='76,58 84,52 84,64' fill='#81c784'/>
    <circle cx='61' cy='56' r='1.8' fill='#3b1f5e'/>
    <!-- stripes -->
    <path d='M36 28 Q42 24 48 28' stroke='#e08a20' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none'/>
    <path d='M45 70 Q45 66 51 70' stroke='#e08a20' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none'/>
    <!-- tail -->
    <path d='M68 80 Q82 78 80 64' stroke='#f9a825' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M80 64 Q79 60 76 60' stroke='#ffe082' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
